text: For the music director, a psalm of David.
May ADONAI answer you in the day of trouble! May the Name of the God of Jacob set you up securely on high.
May He send you help from the Sanctuary and support you from Zion.
May He remember all your meal offerings and accept the fat of your burnt offering. Selah
May He grant you your heart’s desire and fulfill all your plans.
We will shout for joy in your victory and lift up our banners in the Name of our God! May ADONAI fulfill all your petitions.
Now I know that ADONAI saves His anointed. He answers him from His holy heaven with saving strength of His right hand.
Some have chariots, some have horses, but we remember the Name of ADONAI our God.
They have collapsed and fallen, but we rise up and support each other.
ADONAI, save the king! Answer us on the day we call!
